78140.subject: Ethena Wants All Of Its Revenue Buying ENA
78140.body:
**gm, Defiers!**

These are the biggest stories in DeFi and crypto:

* **[Ethena](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/ethena-proposes-sending-all-net-revenue-to-ena-buybacks)**[ puts all of its net revenue up for ENA buybacks](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/ethena-proposes-sending-all-net-revenue-to-ena-buybacks)

* **[Moonwell](https://thedefiant.io/news/hacks/moonwell-loses-8-7-million-to-mamo-price-manipulation-on-base)**[ loses $8.7 million and halts borrowing on Base](https://thedefiant.io/news/hacks/moonwell-loses-8-7-million-to-mamo-price-manipulation-on-base)

* **[Bitcoin](https://thedefiant.io/news/markets/bitcoin-clears-usd80-000-as-schwab-adds-solana)**[ clears $80,000 as Schwab adds three tokens](https://thedefiant.io/news/markets/bitcoin-clears-usd80-000-as-schwab-adds-solana)

* **[Machi Big Brother](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/friend-soars-after-machi-big-brother-bids-usd1-million-for-friend-tech)**[ bids $1 million for a friend.tech nobody owns](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/friend-soars-after-machi-big-brother-bids-usd1-million-for-friend-tech)

The Ethena Foundation put a vote on Snapshot on Thursday that would send effectively all of the protocol's net revenue into buying ENA.

The same announcement [hands protocol intellectual property and accrued value to the Foundation](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/ethena-proposes-sending-all-net-revenue-to-ena-buybacks), with Ethena Labs equity investors keeping no residual claim on protocol cash flow. The Foundation also said it bought out the remaining locked ENA held by seed investors who had been selling for nine months, and agreed with lead investors to release unvested venture tokens so the monthly unlocks stop. It named no investors and disclosed no price.

ENA rose 21.9% to $0.1669, its biggest one-day move among the 150 largest tokens after VeChain. Ethena generates $310 million of annualized fees, of which $5.3 million currently reaches the protocol as revenue.

**Read more below!**

———————————————————————————

———————————————————————————

##### DEFI

## Ethena Proposes Sending All Net Revenue to ENA Buybacks

The Ethena Foundation [opened a governance vote](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/ethena-proposes-sending-all-net-revenue-to-ena-buybacks) to direct all net revenue generated across Ethena-branded businesses into programmatic ENA buybacks. The vote went live on Snapshot on Thursday after Risk Committee approval, and the Foundation did not state a closing date. A Master Framework Agreement between Ethena Labs and the Foundation assigns protocol intellectual property and ownership of accrued value exclusively to the Foundation, governed by ENA holders, with Labs equity investors retaining no residual claim on protocol cash flow. Ethena's token-transparency filing describes Labs as a Portuguese company that provides services to the Foundation, holds no ownership interest in it, and cannot appoint or remove its directors.
